The '''Bait Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked from the {{Coll|Raw Cod 3}}, {{Coll|Raw Cod 5}}, and {{Coll|Raw Cod 7}} collections with increasing capacity. The '''{{ID|Small Bait Sack!Small Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the '''{{ID|Medium Bait Sack!Medium Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the '''{{ID|Large Bait Sack!Large Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item.

Baits in the '''Bait Sack''' can be interacted with {{Keypress|Shift|Left Click}} to be favored as the currently used [[Fishing Bait]]. Usage of baits from the '''Bait Sack''' can be disabled by clicking '''Use Bait From Sacks''' button in the sack's inventory.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Bait Sack''' replaced the [[Fishing Bag]].
* The '''Bait Sack''' was added by {{RN|YT|CandyPat}} as part of the [[Minister Election]]s.
** This minister initially wanted to add a Capybara Pet which could double [[Dye]] drops. However that idea didn't work and was changed into the Capybara Sanctuary, which would give blessings that give temporary foraging buffs. These ideas where scrapped and replaced with the '''Bait Sack'''.
* The '''Bait Sack''' is the only [[Sacks|Sack]] that can be opened directly through commands.
* With a full '''Large Bait Sack''', filleting all {{Item|Obfuscated-2 (Diamond)|20160}} would reward the player with {{Item|Magmafish|{{#EXPR: 20160*120}}}}, worth {{BZC|{{#EXPR: 20160*120/5120}} Gold Magmafish}}.
